Core ComfyUI must not make outbound internet requests; uploads, telemetry, analytics, tracking, update checks and similar paths are refused. Anchor term CoreComfyUI is queued as TP-000008.

Optimized backend functions, dispatch helpers and capability-selected callables are opaque; higher-level code must not inspect function identity, names, modules, or implementation details. Anchor term AttentionBackend is queued as TP-000009.
optimized_attention is capability-selected at module load: attention_basic default, replaced by sage/flash/xformers/pytorch based on model_management capability checks.

comfy/ops.py wraps scaled_dot_product_attention with sdpa_kernel(SDPA_BACKEND_PRIORITY, set_priority=True) ordering FLASH_ATTENTION > CUDNN_ATTENTION > EFFICIENT_ATTENTION > MATH when torch supports set_priority.
custom_nodes/ plugins are dynamically loaded at startup by init_external_custom_nodes via load_custom_node(module_parent='custom_nodes'); they are external to core, not part of the core modules.
folder_path_test.py asserts exactly one 'custom_nodes' folder path is registered, pinning the core/custom_nodes directory contract in tests.
All models should use the optimized attention function selected by ComfyUI; the selection is opaque to callers (INV-BACKEND-001 anchor confirmed for TERM-ATTNBACKEND).

pick_operations(weight_dtype, compute_dtype, load_device, disable_fast_fp8, fp8_optimizations, model_config) is the operations factory: model_config.quant_config routes to mixed_precision_ops(quant_config, compute_dtype), otherwise it selects among fp8_ops/manual_cast/disable_weight_init paths.

BaseModel acquires its op set via comfy.ops.pick_operations(...) when building the diffusion model and comfy/controlnet.py does the same, so callers depend on the factory rather than concrete op classes.

safe_linear is a fork-specific CUDA fallback: a per-device force set (CUDA_LINEAR_FORCE_MATMUL_DEVICES) routes eligible inputs to _linear_via_matmul; otherwise an F.linear RuntimeError matching the allowlist (_should_retry_cuda_linear) is retried once after discard_cuda_async_error + soft_empty_cache + contiguous().
Fork-added CPU-safe tests pin safe_linear fallback behavior: f_linear preference when devices are not forced and fallback skipped for CPU tensors.

CODEBASE_ANALYSIS.md cites safe_linear at ops.py:1146-1215 and describes a process-global flag, but current code is at comfy/ops.py#L1341-L1399 with a per-device CUDA_LINEAR_FORCE_MATMUL_DEVICES set; the analysis document's line references are stale relative to the current per-device fallback.
class VAE lives in comfy/sd.py (there is no comfy/vae.py); its __init__ handles diffusers format conversion and a fork-specific seedvr2 VAE state-dict detection branch.
VAEDecode/VAEDecodeTiled/VAEEncode/VAEEncodeTiled/VAEEncodeForInpaint nodes wrap VAE instances; the node layer drives VAE encode/decode APIs while tiled policy stays inside VAE.
pick_operations returns mixed_precision_ops immediately when model_config.quant_config is set, otherwise selects fp8/displaced ops by device capability.
safe_linear per-device CUDA fallback behavior is pinned by CPU-safe unit tests (f_linear preference and forced matmul devices).
VAEDecodeTiled node consumes a VAE instance and unwraps NestedTensor samples before tiled decode.
SeedVR2 VAE forward return contract (tensor vs tuple) is pinned by regression tests raising on unknown forward modes.
